mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies with a temperature of 70 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park. We are also under a Waning Gibbous moon, and the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 3:29 AM. It will rise in the northwest near Verona High School and travel across the sky toward the northeast near Home Depot, remaining low near the horizon.

Mayor Luke Diaz has proclaimed September 2026 as Hunger Action Month in Verona. This initiative aims to tackle food insecurity, which impacts 1 in 8 residents in Southwest Wisconsin. The proclamation highlights that 72,000 people in Dane County face food insecurity, and it encourages residents to support efforts by Second Harvest Foodbank through volunteering and donations to ensure everyone in our community has access to nutritious meals.

We have a full calendar for the coming days! Today you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have several trivia events including nights at Hop Haus Brewing Co and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. On September 2, the schedule includes the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, live music at Paddy Mac's, and trivia at both Paddy Mac's and The Bogey Factory. Looking further ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company on September 4.

In our weekly look at police activity, on August 17, the Verona Police Department assisted the Department of Corrections by locating a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road to take him into custody for a probation violation.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for the morning hours, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10:00 AM today. Stop by to discover the flavor of the day!
